headline: OpenAI Seeks $30B at $1.4T Valuation Amid Safety Scrutiny
body: OpenAI is raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation while simultaneously facing security breaches, employee safety warnings, and legal action over inadequate safeguards. The funding push comes as the company delayed its next model release citing safety concerns, creating a critical tension between growth and responsible AI governance. For healthcare AI stakeholders, this signals that even the largest AI vendors are wrestling with core safety and security challenges that directly impact clinical deployment readiness. Organizations evaluating OpenAI's models for EHR integration or patient-facing applications should scrutinize their security practices and safety protocols before committing to production workflows. The contrast between fundraising ambitions and acknowledged safety gaps highlights why healthcare systems need rigorous vendor diligence on AI governance, not just capability assessments.
